LanguageData.AOPatch_SkeletonNotice: This build is a post-rewrite skeleton: no compatibility logic is implemented yet. All previous patches have been removed and will return module by module.
LanguageData.AOPatch_MasterDesc: Master switch. When off, no patches are installed.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatEnabledDesc: Hand ProxyHeat's range heating to AO's simulation field. Enabling this force-disables ProxyHeat's own read-value layer.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatAirModeDesc: Default for newly placed buildings. Inject the range delta into the air temperature field. Overridable per building.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatGroundModeDesc: Default for newly placed buildings. Inject into the ground temperature field; slower but reaches through roofs, no effect on vacuum maps. Overridable per building.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatJetModeDesc: Default for newly placed buildings. Blows hot air outwards along true radials from the building centre (AO native wind field). Overridable per building.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatStrengthDesc: Click to adjust how fast this device brings its range to the target temperature.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatJetSpeedDesc: Click to adjust this device's jet outlet speed.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatAirDesc: This building's range delta is injected into the air temperature field.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatSoilDesc: This building's range delta is injected into the ground temperature field. Slower, but the heat reaches through roofs.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatJetDesc: This building blows a heat jet forward along its facing. Suited to chimneys and hot-air outlets.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatStackingDesc: Overlapping heat sources add their deltas; off takes the maximum instead.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatIndoorDefault: New sources affect indoors by default
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatIndoorDefaultDesc: Newly spawned buildings include indoor cells in their range by default. Can be overridden per building on its gizmo bar.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatCoolingDesc: Lets coolers use the range effect too. May cancel out AO's point sources; off by default.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatIndoorsDesc: When on, this device's range also covers indoor cells; when off it only applies outdoors.
LanguageData.AOPatch_VteProxyHeatDesc: VTE-ProxyHeatPatch rewrites ProxyHeat's method structure and may prevent this mod's range effect from working. Please remove that patch from the mod list and restart.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatDebugLogDesc: Print a status summary (source count, active count, injected total) to the developer log. Enable when the range effect appears not to work.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatJetLayersDesc: Jets start from the ring around the building; each extra layer sits one cell further out. Cells blocked by walls produce no jet.
LanguageData.AOPatch_ProxyHeatJetSpeedHint: Initial jet speed is derived from the building radius; use the per-building Jet Speed button to fine-tune.
LanguageData.JGC_NaturalVent_Desc: Linked to this vent's speed slider: any non-zero speed means natural ventilation is on. Clicking this button sets the slider to 0 (off) or the maximum (on); dragging the slider updates this button too. While intensive exchange is running the slider is locked at 0. Off by default.
LanguageData.JGC_NaturalVent_Disabled: Unavailable while intensive exchange is running.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Omni_TargetsDesc: Set the atmosphere targets shared by every dome and biosphere on this map. AO pins the covered cells to these values each simulation step.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Omni_BiosphereTemperatureLocked: AO has taken over temperature; this setting no longer applies
LanguageData.AOPatch_Omni_IsolationDesc: When enabled, the cells covered by domes and biospheres are marked impassable in AO's atmosphere mask, cutting off all air exchange with the outside. When disabled, the interior is still pinned to the target values but will exchange air with the outside through advection and diffusion.
